09:06 Übergabe ans Applikationsteam: Browser-Aufruf zur weiteren Eingrenzung erneut erfasst. Die Ausschnitte gehören zum selben Ticket.

Confirmed data breach. An external recipient downloaded statements for 4,200 customers from a shared link that support had enabled for a single recipient. The download logs and the file manifest confirm that the export included customer names, account numbers and invoice details. The link has been revoked. Customers can still sign in, retrieve their own statements and submit orders. The investigation has confirmed disclosure of the downloaded files. The recipient has not confirmed deletion.
